resolution: Removed the UV drag hot-path rebuild: raw pointer samples now retain the exact newest geometry in refs and coalesce React previews to host-frame cadence; static islands and active-part outlines are reference-cached; checker compositing moved into the atlas shader; grid, face, boundary, selection, rotation, and guide lines now use the native Graph.Polyline segment primitive instead of rebuilding and parsing Graph.Path strings. Added segment parity regressions and passed 17/17 UV tests, editor TypeScript check, and ReleaseFast ship.
